title: The Cosmos is Infinite
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.12 Linked Discourses 24.12
  • 1. Sotāpattivagga 1. Stream-Entry

Anantavāsutta The Cosmos is Infinite

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘anantavā loko’”ti? ‘The cosmos is infinite’?” …

“Bhagavaṁmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā …pe… niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Dvādasamaṁ.
